prompts.d: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity desktop website SECTION mockup for 常春藤幼兒園 in Taiwan, only the "孩子的一天" section, 1536x1024 landscape. Sophisticated warm human editorial design for parents, all Traditional Chinese Taiwan text, generous legible typography. Use supplied reference images as documentary school photography inserts, preserve their real subjects, don't fabricate school photographs or claims. Brand forest green #244C38, warm ivory #FFFDF5, sage #E7EDE1, restrained mustard #E3C96D. No browser frame, no device frame, no global site navigation, no cartoon children or toy icons. Fonts strong rounded Traditional Chinese headlines with clean readable body. Accurate headline as specified, supporting text may be short. Design must be buildable HTML/CSS and have clear 44px controls. Direction D: "日常照片牆". Headline "每一個小日常，都值得被看見。" Background deep forest green, ivory headline left, small description right. Under headline an art-directed asymmetric collage image grid: huge wide children-exploring photo occupying left 60%; right tall smiling child portrait; below two medium campus and teacher-child pictures and small ivory text panel with two visible links "一起用餐" and "安靜片刻". Keep image geometry aligned with 16px gaps, no round cards. Each photo has concise overlay label anchored bottom on subtle dark gradient, small plus-circle at top right (click expands story). Mix natural wide and portrait images. Small footer text "選一個片刻，走進孩子的日常。" No time stamps. Strong picture-wall identity, not tabs or carousel.
prompts.e: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity desktop website SECTION mockup for 常春藤幼兒園 in Taiwan, only the "孩子的一天" section, 1536x1024 landscape. Sophisticated warm human editorial design for parents, all Traditional Chinese Taiwan text, generous legible typography. Use supplied reference images as documentary school photography inserts, preserve their real subjects, don't fabricate school photographs or claims. Brand forest green #244C38, warm ivory #FFFDF5, sage #E7EDE1, restrained mustard #E3C96D. No browser frame, no device frame, no global site navigation, no cartoon children or toy icons. Fonts strong rounded Traditional Chinese headlines with clean readable body. Accurate headline as specified, supporting text may be short. Design must be buildable HTML/CSS and have clear 44px controls. Direction E: "孩子的生活手帳". Headline "今天，又多了一點點長大。" Layout tactile open notebook double-page spread on warm light sage desktop surface. Above: three slim chapter bookmarks "上午｜出發與發現", "午間｜照顧自己", "午後｜玩耍與分享". The open ivory spread has thin center fold and subtle paper ruled lines only in small writing area. Default morning spread: left page strong line "一聲早安，故事開始。" with smaller 4:3 campus photo in a white photo mat with printed caption and one short sentence; right page larger tilted 2deg documentary photo children exploring with title "原來，世界有好多為什麼。" below plus one short paragraph. A small restrained yellow page tag "上午". Avoid fake handwritten signature and fake teacher quotes. Bottom natural previous/next chapter controls and "01 / 03". Book motif airy and elegant, not childish scrapbook overload. Two different moments visible simultaneously. No image carousel.

Brand forest green #244C38, warm ivory #FFFDF5, sage #E7EDE1, restrained mustard #E3C96D. No browser frame, no device frame, no global site navigation, no cartoon children or toy icons. Design must be buildable HTML/CSS and have clear 44px controls. Direction F: "從家長的好奇開始". Headline "你在意的小事，是我們想聊的大事。" Main layout warm ivory, left 45% large accordion questions, right 55% tall emotional real photo of adult comforting child in documentary scene (first reference) paired with small campus image offset bottom right. First question open "第一次上學，孩子能慢慢適應嗎？", short paragraph says "從熟悉環境、認識老師開始，一起聊聊孩子的步調。" label "從早安入園開始看". Other questions closed with plus icon: "吃飯和休息，會怎麼被陪伴？", "在遊戲裡，孩子發現了什麼？", "今天的小故事，怎麼帶回家？". Clear expansive 80px rows and thin warm-gray rules, active row deepgreen number "01". Photo caption "陪伴，是每一天的開始。" Bottom compact outlined button with checkmark "預約參觀". No invented guarantees, no filter pills, no timeline. Design serious reassuring but warm and distinctive.
